extDescription.message: Auto ChatGPT for your prompts at scale. Batch generate and auto-download responses and images on ChatGPT.com.

modeHint_text.message: A text reply for every prompt.

modeHint_ingredients.message: Your images are sent with each prompt; the text replies are collected.

modeHint_textToImage.message: Images from text descriptions. Every generated image is downloaded.

modeHint_imageToImage.message: Each prompt is sent with your source images to transform them.

autoAddCharactersHint.message: Attaches the images whose file name is mentioned in the prompt: hero.png goes with prompts that mention "hero".

promptsPlaceholder.message: Enter prompts. Separate each prompt with a blank line.

backgroundHint.message: The browser pauses chatgpt.com when its tab is hidden. Background mode shares the chatgpt.com tab (pick it in the dialog) so it keeps working behind other windows. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.

keepPanelOpen.message: Keep this panel open while the queue runs. If it closes, Run picks up where it stopped.

copyDiagnosticsHint.message: Copies what the extension sees on the ChatGPT page (no prompt or reply text). Paste it into a bug report.

modelHint.message: Leave empty to keep the model chosen in ChatGPT. Otherwise the model id from chatgpt.com/?model=… (e.g. gpt-5).

promptModeHint.message: Concat: the next prompt continues in the same chat. Last Image: the image made by the previous prompt is used as this prompt's input. Click a prompt's tag in the queue to change it.

maxImageInputs.message: Max Input Images per Prompt (Image to Image)

keepTabActive.message: Keep the ChatGPT tab in front while running

keepTabActiveHint.message: With one prompt at a time, the ChatGPT tab is brought to the front of its window before each prompt.

samplePrompt.message: A cozy cabin in the snow

logNoPrompts.message: Enter at least one prompt first.

logNeedSourceImages.message: Image to Image needs at least one source image: upload one first.

logNeedHostAccess.message: Allow access to chatgpt.com to run the queue.

logAlreadyRunning.message: The queue is already running in another panel.

logStopped.message: Stopped. Run continues where it stopped.

logFixing.message: Fix Error: stopping ChatGPT, closing dialogs and reloading the chat

logSequential.message: Concat / Last Image prompts run one at a time.

logSent.message: Prompt {0}: sent, waiting for the reply

logWaitingForImage.message: Prompt {0}: ChatGPT is drawing the image

logNudged.message: Prompt {0}: ChatGPT answered without an image, asked it to generate the image

logResumed.message: Prompt {0}: already sent before the interruption, collected its reply instead of sending it again

logRefused.message: Prompt {0}: refused by ChatGPT — trying once more

logInterrupted.message: Prompt {0}: {1} — the next try picks up its reply

logTabActivated.message: Brought the ChatGPT tab to the front

logTabHidden.message: The ChatGPT tab is hidden. If prompts stall, use background mode or keep the tab visible.

logBackgroundFailed.message: Background mode not started: {0}. Opening the panel in its own window (right-click the toolbar button) may help.
